PROC
PROC_BlockUseOfItem(_Player, (ITEM)S_PLA_StuckHalfElfRubble_f67f111e-160e-4050-ba9e-a16d034f7434)
AND
DB_Players(_Player)
AND
NOT DB_CustomUseItemResponse(_Player, (ITEM)S_PLA_StuckHalfElfRubble_f67f111e-160e-4050-ba9e-a16d034f7434, 0)
AND

THEN

PROC

AND
CrimeGetNewID(_CrimeID)
THEN

IF
TemplateUseFinished(_Player,(ITEMROOT)QUEST_COL_MF_BasRelief_A_26b29e36-7f64-422c-8513-4109d356ba4a,_Relief,1)
AND

AND
QRY_StartDialogCustom_Fixed(COL_NecroLab_GrandDesignSculpture_25c4347c-923c-ffea-03de-a293893a81ed,_Relief,_Player,0,0,1,0)
